name: asset-generator
description: Generate game-ready 3D and 2D assets for Unity, Godot, Roblox Studio and Unreal Engine.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,blue "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
